text: Hi from Austria. Venice is your center and my fleet in Trieste is next to it. Let's keep the peace this year: I'll hold the Balkans and Tyrol, you keep Venice and Rome. If you want to move on Tunis or Greece later, we can talk. Are you willing to stay out of Trieste?

Austria here. I'm not planning to attack you. Rumania and Serbia are open; I'd rather we both take neutrals than fight. If you move F SEV to RUM, I'd take SER with my army from Budapest, so we don't collide. Can we agree on that?

Hello from England. I propose we keep the Channel safe: I will move my fleets away from BRE and ENG, and you keep your fleet out of the North Sea and Mid-Atlantic. Later we can coordinate against whoever grows too fast. Happy to hear your thoughts.
England here. I have no quarrel with you. I suggest we both aim for neutral centers like HOL and DEN rather than fighting each other this year. Let me know if you want to coordinate.

Hello from France. Proposal: I'll keep the Channel open for you and stay out of the North Sea and London area. In return, let's both focus on expansion away from each other: I'll look at Spain and Belgium, you take Norway and Holland when possible. Happy to talk about a non-aggression pact for 1901.

France here. I have no quarrel with you this year. If you stay out of Burgundy and Picardy, I'll keep my armies on the western side and won't move against Munich or Berlin. Let me know if you'd like to coordinate on Belgium or Holland.

Hi from Germany. Neither of us gains by fighting early. I suggest we both focus on neutrals: I'll take Holland and Denmark, and you take Belgium. Let's keep the Burgundy border quiet this year. Happy to hear your plans.
Germany here. I'm not planning to move on Warsaw or Sevastopol. I'd like to keep our border calm while I expand west into the neutrals. If you want to coordinate against Austria later, let me know.
Germany to Austria: I have no interest in attacking you this year. I'm taking Holland and Denmark. Let's keep Tyrolia and Bohemia quiet for now.

Hi Austria. I'm considering a move on Trieste. If you'd rather keep your fleet there, I'm happy to talk about a deal: I'd stay out of Vienna and Budapest, and you could help me take centers elsewhere later. Interested?

Hi France. Italy is looking for a friendly neighbour in the west. I'll keep my armies out of Marseille and Piedmont-side moves toward you if you do the same. Happy to coordinate on whatever neutrals are left (Tunis, Spain) so we don't block each other.

Hello from Russia. Neutral RUM is open. My F SEV can take it this spring. Would you be willing to keep your A BUD out of Rumania and focus on Serbia and Trieste, with us both staying out of each other's way? I'd rather stay friends and aim south at Turkey than fight you.

Russia here. I have no quarrel with you right now. I'd like to keep the Black Sea calm: I'll leave Armenia and Ankara alone if you keep your fleet out of Sevastopol and Rumania. Let me know if you agree.

Hello from Turkey. Russia is my northern neighbour and I would rather not fight you while the Balkans are open. I plan to take Bulgaria this spring and then move on Greece and Rumania. Could we agree to no moves into each other's home areas (Armenia and Sevastopol are yours to keep, Ankara and Smyrna mine)? I would be glad to hear your thoughts.

Turkey here. I am taking Bulgaria this season. I have no interest in Serbia or Trieste while you focus on Italy or Russia. If you move against Serbia, I would be happy to keep my fleets away from the Aegean and Adriatic side. Let me know your plans.
Austria here. Agreed on the split: I take SER with A BUD, you take RUM with F SEV. I'll keep my armies out of Rumania. Let's both hold our other borders this spring and talk about Turkey next year.
Austria here. I'm not moving on Trieste or Venice this spring. My fleet stays put. If you keep out of Vienna and Budapest, we can stay at peace and look at Tunis or Greece together later.

England here. Agreed on the Channel: I keep my fleets out of BRE and ENG, and you keep yours out of the North Sea and London area. I will take NWY and HOL, you take SPA and BEL. Let's talk again in 1902.
England here. I'm not planning to attack you. I'd like to split the neutrals: I go for NWY and HOL, you take DEN and SWE if you can reach them. Keep your fleets out of the North Sea and we're fine.

France here. Agreed on keeping the Channel calm. I'll move BRE to MAO this spring, which keeps my fleet out of the North Sea and London. I'm taking Spain with my army, so no need to contest it. Let's keep it that way.
France here. Agreed, I'm not moving on Piedmont or Tunis. My army goes to Spain this year. Let's keep the south quiet and I'll watch for Austria.
France here. I'll stay off Burgundy this turn if you hold Munich. Belgium is open for me, so I'd rather not see you move there.

Germany here. Agreed on the neutrals: I take Holland and Denmark, you take Belgium. I'll keep Munich and Berlin defensive and won't enter Burgundy this year. If you want, I can support you into Burgundy next year against Italy or Austria.
Germany here. I'm staying out of Warsaw and Sevastopol. If Austria moves on you, I'm open to a joint move against Austria next year. Let's keep our border calm this season.

Hi Austria. I'm not going to attack Trieste this spring. Let's keep it peaceful: I'll stay out of Vienna and Budapest, and you keep your fleet off Venice and Rome. If you want to split Tyrol later, let's talk before any moves.
Hi France. Italy will keep its armies out of Marseille and Piedmont this year. Let's both aim for the neutrals (Tunis, Spain) and avoid blocking each other there.

Russia here. Agreed on the split: I take RUM with F SEV, you take SER with A BUD. Let's keep it that way and I'll stay out of Galicia and Vienna's area this year. If you want, I can help later against Germany or Turkey, but tell me your plan first.
Russia here. Fine by me: no moves into Armenia or Ankara from my side, and keep your fleet out of Sevastopol and Rumania. I'm taking RUM this spring, so please don't try to go there.
Russia here. I'm keeping my armies defensive this spring and won't move on Berlin or Kiel. If you go west, I'd like you to stay out of Prussia and Livonia for now.

Turkey here. Agreed on the Black Sea: my fleets stay out of Sevastopol and Rumania, and I'll keep Ankara and Smyrna defensive toward you. I'm taking Bulgaria this spring. If you ever want to strike Germany or Austria instead, let me know.
Turkey again. I'm moving A CON to Bulgaria this spring, not Serbia. I'd rather we both keep the Balkans quiet toward each other. If you're pressing Russia, I can help later.

Austria here. Thanks for keeping Serbia clear. I'm holding Serbia this autumn. If Russia's F RUM moves on Bulgaria, I'd be glad to coordinate against Russia with you later.

France here. I'm holding Paris and staying out of Burgundy this spring. Keep Munich quiet and we're fine. If you want Belgium next year, let's talk about it then.
France here. Thanks for keeping Marseille quiet. I'm holding Spain and moving to Portugal with my fleet, so Tunis is yours to take. Let's keep the south calm.

Germany here. Still on for the split: I take Holland and Denmark, you take Belgium. Note England may try for HOL too, so I'll hold HOL this turn. Next year, if you want to hit Italy's Piedmont or Burgundy area, I can support you from Munich.
Germany here. I'm keeping Berlin and Munich defensive and out of Prussia and Livonia. If Austria comes at you, I'm open to a joint move against Austria next year.
Italy here. Agreed on peace this autumn. I'll keep A VEN and A ROM home and stay out of Vienna and Budapest. If you keep F TRI holding, we're fine. Let's talk again before any spring moves.

Russia here. Holding the Serbia/Rumania split. I'm keeping my armies on defense toward Galicia this spring. Next year, if you want to press Turkey in the Balkans, tell me your timing and we can coordinate.
